runs.title: First radar: three official routes visible
runs.summary: Hedera, Cyfrin and Nexo visibly invite applications; reward and deadline gaps remain.

runs.title: Six open routes; a 30 Sep trading deadline
runs.summary: Aster, Elk and Nomis join the checked open table; Bitget’s distinct Trading Builder campaign is time-limited.

runs.title: Six routes remain; MetaMask has no confirmed public form
runs.summary: The established six routes remain; MetaMask’s official forum distinguishes a voluntary role from a currently confirmed public application.

runs.title: Soneium opens; Nexo route disappears
runs.summary: Soneium and Torium enter the open table from current issuer pages, while Nexo’s old ambassador path no longer provides a public route.

runs.title: Nexo’s form returns; Oasis and Fiber add routes
runs.summary: Nexo’s official page again shows its ambassador form, while Oasis and Fiber provide new issuer-linked routes with different payment and data conditions.
